visual.title: One stable direction and one unstable direction
visual.caption: The phase plane draws the vector field of a linear system. A saddle has one eigenvalue positive and one negative, so solutions leave along one eigenvector and approach along the other.

predict.question: The matrix diag(2, minus 3) has eigenvalues 2 and minus 3. What kind of equilibrium is the origin?
predict.explain: One eigenvalue is positive and one is negative. The origin is a saddle, with departure along the positive eigenvector and approach along the negative one.
